senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
A buttock.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Steady, firm, immovable.
2 Stayed, stopped.
3 Determined, resolved, decreed, established.
4 Upright, virtuous, steady in conduct.
5 Agreed, engaged, contracted, promised.
6 Risen, got up.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or be, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Firm, unmoved, calm.
E.
स्थित, and धी intellect.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Calm, content, free from desire.
E.
स्थित, and प्रज्ञा wisdom.

m. (-मा)
A faithful friend.
E.
स्थित established, and प्रेमन् affection.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Staying, abiding, stationary.
2 Waiting, attending.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, क्तवतु aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Stay, staying, being fixed or stationary.
2 Correctness of conduct, continuance in the path of duty.
3 Limit, boundary, term.
4 Stop, cessation, pause.
5 Determination, order, decree.
6 Honor, dignity.
7 (In astronomy,) Duration of an eclipse.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or stand, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Firm, stable.
2 Steady, (in purpose, or conduct,) upright, firm, virtuous.
E.
स्थिति, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what fixes, places, &c.
n. (-कं)
Elasticity.
E.
स्थिति, and स्थापक what causes to stay.

ind.
Having stayed, stood, stopped, been, &c.
E.
स्था to stay, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Firm, fixed, steady, immovable.
2 Hard, solid.
3 Permanent, durable, lasting.
4 Firm, steady, (morally,) uninfluenced by pleasure or pain, &c.
5 Cool, collected.
6 Constant, faithful.
m. (-रः)
1 A deity, an immortal.
2 KĀRTTIKEYA.
3 A mountain.
4 A tree.
5 Final emancipation from existence.
6 The planet SATURN.
7 A bull.
f. (-रा)
1 The earth.
2 A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
3 A medicinal root, commonly Kākolī.
4 Silk-cotton tree.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or be, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.

m. (-न्धः)
The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.)
f. (-न्धा)
1 The Pandanus odoratissimus.
2 Trumpet flower.
E.
स्थिर lasting, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-क्रः)
A Bauddha saint.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तं)
Firm, resolute, steady, constant.
E.
स्थिर firm, चेतस् the mind.

m. (-दः)
The Bhojpatra or birch tree of the Himālaya mountains.
E.
स्थिर firm, and छद a leaf.

m. (-यः)
A tree by the road side, &c. giving shelter to travellers or persons passing.
E.
स्थिर lasting, and छाया shade.

m. (-ह्वः)
A fish.
E.
स्थिर immovable, and जिह्वा the tongue.

f. (-ता)
The silk-cotton tree.
E.
स्थिर lasting (a long time), and जीवित alive.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Firm, fixed, stationary.
2 Permanent, durable, eternal.
E.
स्थिर firm, तरप् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Stability, firmness.
2 Moral firmness, fortitude.
E.
स्थिर with तल् added; also with त्व, स्थिरत्वं.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
1 A snake.
2 VIṢṆU in the boar Avatāra.
E.
स्थिर hard, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.

m. (-त्रः)
The marshy date tree.
E.
स्थिर lasting, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.)
2 The Bakul, (Mimusops elengi.)
E.
स्थिर lasting, and पुष्प a flower.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Steady, firm, deliberate.
E.
स्थिर, and मति mind.

m. (-निः)
A large tree, one that gives shade and shelter.
E.
स्थिर firm, lasting, and योनि place of production.

m. (-नः)
A Vidyādhara, a peculiar kind of demi-god.
E.
स्थिर perpetual, यौवन youth.

f. (-ङ्गा)
1 Indigo.
2 Dār-haldi, a sort of Curcuma.
E.
स्थिर lasting, and रङ्ग colour or dye.

m. (-पः)
The marshy date tree.
E.
स्थिर hard or lasting, and अंह्रिप tree.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
1 Firm, resolute, unmoved.
2 Stable, steady.
E.
स्थिर, and आत्मन् self.

m. (-युः)
The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
E.
स्थिर lasting long, and आयु or आयुस् life, whence also स्थिरायुस् m. (-युः).
